text:
lucy_sales: Heads up - OrionBridge wants a 7-day POC next Wed. Must-haves: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning + deprovision, group->role bindings with conflict resolution, domain ownership proof for multiple subdomains, and a short Hosted vs Dedicated cost write-up. Any immediate concerns?

jia_solutions: Hosted is fastest but check EU data residency clause. If they need tenant isolation we move to Dedicated/Private. Also confirm whether delegated tenant admins are required.

omar_engineering: Traffic estimate: ~800 MAU, spikes to ~90 r/s. Dedicated gives predictable p95; Hosted can work for POC with rate limits. SCIM: we support delta sync and a bulk import endpoint. Default throttling ~5 req/s with 429/backoff. For initial import we provide staging bulk endpoint. Sample SCIM PATCH we usually share:
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/abc123
Content-Type: application/json
{"Operations":[{"op":"replace","value":{"active":false}}]}

neha_security: Security checklist: require SAML signed responses (SHA256) and recommend encrypted attributes if PHI/PII in assertions. If Private, confirm KMS provider (AWS KMS or GCP KMS) and key rotation policy. Sent security questionnaire link: https://redwood.ai/sec-qa.

lucy_sales: Customer prefers Hosted. Legal may push EU residency. Also asks: can one Okta group map to multiple roles and do we support role priority/hierarchy?

omar_engineering: Yes. Group -> multiple roles supported; we resolve conflicts via explicit numeric priority. We can enable the mapping UI for the POC and demo role precedence. Tenant-level admin scopes exist for delegated admin.

jia_solutions: Domain proofing: TXT record verification token (e.g., _rwd.orionbridge.example) and we support mapping multiple verified domains to one tenant and tenant lock.

neha_security: Note SAML logout caveat: SP-initiated logout may not clear IdP session cookies; recommend session TTL policy and signed logout if they require it.

ops-bot: provision 1825001120: ephemeral-poc pool created (2x A10G)  expires in 14d.

lucy_sales: Action items: 1) Omar - quick pricing table Hosted vs Dedicated for 7d (include EU premium). 2) Jia - draft SOW + success criteria. 3) Neha - finalize security QA + sample SAML metadata. 4) Omar - SCIM bulk import guide. Can we have quote + SOW + metadata by Thu EOD? Customer wants kickoff Mon. Thanks!
